answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent identity to a remotely attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), verified against an approved code image before the agent can participate. Reproducing that identity then requires provisioning and attesting another genuine enclave, so copying a virtual machine alone is insufficient; scaling identities entails access to physical silicon rather than cheap VM duplication. A juniper, lotus, or horizon deployment still depends on sound key management and attestation policy.
